axes.concept: A scene workbench for reopening saved work: a persistent project index, derived scene view and selected-project inspector inside the established Pictures shell.
axes.layout: One continuous sheet with 276px / flexible / 238px columns; tablet keeps the index beside a stacked scene/detail area; phone stacks index, scene and detail.
axes.navigation: Shared horizontal Taller 3D / Proyectos guardados routes; local pressed-state project selection followed by explicit Open project; phone anchors connect project list and scene preview.
axes.typography: Existing local Geist Sans and Geist Mono; 24px page title, 20px inspector, 16px index heading, 14–15px body and 12–13px metadata. No new family.
axes.density: Compact divided project records beside a dominant scene and a sparse reading inspector. Existing 32px sheet, 18px field and pill control shapes; 24px desktop and 20px phone insets.
axes.components: Installed shadcn/Base UI Button and Input, Skeleton and Animate UI Dialog; native selects/account disclosure, semantic project rows and a local illustrative scene SVG.
axes.colour: Exact Pictures background/surface/text/accent and semantic state tokens; workshop-visor surface for the scene. Control edges use the sibling texto-tenue alias. No new palette.
axes.motion: Spatial indexHinge 620ms cubic-bezier(.22,.85,.3,1.08), lateral inspectorDock, 775ms sceneDolly, 65ms rowDepth stagger, statusRegister, shared spring marker and 180ms hover/press. Natural/subtle scale timing; Quieto/still/reduce eliminate movement.
